October 10, 2026


"At Cameco, we are incredibly pleased to see the Saskatchewan government recognizing the essential role nuclear power can play in supporting the province's future growth.” – Cameco CEO Tim Gitzel. Today the province has outlined a plan to advance nuclear power as a key part of long-term energy security, including a goal of at least 2,600 MW of nuclear generation by 2050. As a proud Saskatchewan company, Cameco is looking forward to working alongside governments, Indigenous communities, industry partners, educators, suppliers and local stakeholders to help build a reliable, affordable and carbon-free energy future. Saskatchewan's nuclear future is taking shape, and we're excited to help power the next chapter with the many partners, communities and organizations helping make it possible.
